sections.title: Precision Across the Widest Format
body: Holding tight flatness tolerance gets harder as coating width increases, since even small deviations across a wider surface compound into visible film non-uniformity.

FOM SD 500 holds ≤ 5 µm flatness across its entire surface despite being the largest standard-size head in the steel series, which is what keeps coatings uniform at the full 500 mm width rather than only at narrower settings. Chemically passivated stainless steel 1.4404 construction keeps that precision intact over repeated use, resisting the corrosion that varied ink and slurry chemistries could otherwise introduce over time.
